summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony by analysing the confidential portal data, then building a general recheck-and-act agent product (poller, extraction, recompute, supplier emails, approvals) with a demo instance, README and pitch material before the 12:00 hand-in.
summary.outcome: Found that Soony's plan said all ok while the Collector's Edition and Standard were short (80,000 vs 8,000 art book receipt, failed statue lot, stuck clear cases, offloaded game cards). Built and deployed the Today/Launch app with routines, a sign-off loop, a dry-mail demo instance, a README and many UI fixes, mostly committed on jonas/today-flow; the last 3 commits and the j/k fix were not yet pushed.

repo: Portal data lives in gitignored data/ (raw/, drops/, notes/, img/); .env holds SOONY_PORTAL_TOKEN and .env.example is committed with an empty token.

The portal API has only GET /api/v1/files, /files/{path} and /archive.zip, with no webhooks or notifications; the documented way to detect changes is polling the file list and comparing SHA-256, since files get replaced under the same name.
The team workflow is CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md; tasks are claimed with a Now line in PROGRESS.md.
The shared mailbox sync wrote back a stale copy of the action log and lost records recorded during a multi-second fetch; fixed by appending under the shared lock (commit dd71984).
Routine option matching searched for a literal 'make po,rev' string instead of separate terms, so a routine found its case but sent nothing; fixed in 67ad2ae.
Routines mark cases as seen on the first run, so a failed first run is not retried; routines now run immediately when switched on or saved.
Prepared proposals go stale when their case is decided; they now expire automatically and are deduped across routines (7cab80b).

scripts/demo.sh reset|snapshot|stop controls the demo instance at ask-soony-demo.stenglein.dev; demo mode records mails in data/demo/state/dry_outbox.json instead of sending them and disables mailbox sync, reply check, Teams and portal polling.
Sign-off uses one-time /ok/<token> links and push goes to every subscribed device; ASK_SIGNOFF_SIMULATE=<seconds> auto-approves an escalation as Maren, labelled simulated.
ASK_TEAMS_WEBHOOK is empty in .env, so Teams messages are not sent.
Favicon and app icon links carry a ?v=2 cache-buster; the mark is ink/monochrome and theme-aware.
workflow: Entire only writes a checkpoint when repo files change; sessions that only read files log 'no files modified, skipping checkpoint', and pushes also send Entire checkpoints.
Long-running one-off analysis (200 order confirmations plus 59 scans) was delegated to a subagent, and builder subagents ran in parallel with main-thread work.
Verifying UI fixes in the browser by measuring scroll position and highlighted rows caught issues that type checks did not.
Confidential supplier data was kept local and gitignored, with no values in code and no challenge numbers in the README.
Pointing a new Cloudflare hostname at the wrong tunnel caused a temporary Error 1033; re-routing DNS to the ask-soony tunnel fixed it.

friction: The portal token was initially empty, which blocked data access until the user supplied it.
Real supplier emails were sent from the live instance on every click, so rehearsal needed a separate dry-mail demo instance.
Five approved internal messages and escalations (including 'collect the container' and the Maren escalation) were only recorded and reached nobody, while the UI claimed 'DC site lead has it now'.
Four prepared routine steps failed with 'not an open card' because they were stale after the user had already sent the questions by hand.
PackRight received two more rev C requests after Lin Hui had already said she needed the PDF and change notice first.

The UI had a series of scroll, highlight and navigation problems: the list jumped when a decided case opened, J/K walked inside folded groups so the highlight vanished, and the waiting steps were missing from the left column.
Launch said 'Decide by' even when the case was with Maren.
The demo hostname briefly returned Cloudflare Error 1033 and Safari kept the old yellow favicon.
The Collector's cell would run dry at 11:16 and Standard had stood still since Sat 21:50, so the time pressure limited what could be fixed.
open_items: Push the unpushed commits (dry mail, demo script, favicon, j/k row navigation) on jonas/today-flow.
Write the 3-minute demo script, the pitch outline, the video and the slides for the 12:00 hand-in.
Build the 'What still saves it' section on Launch (latest arrival per blocker, about 900 Collector's copies lost per hour of delay).
Add the question for Felix at the 09:00 office hours: who gets container NHSU4471921 to the DC today?
Delete the duplicate 'Ask Hamburg to count book stock' routine.
Set up an ASK_TEAMS_WEBHOOK in .env if Teams delivery is wanted, and route internal messages and escalations through push.
Maren's view top bar still counts Felix's list and says 'nothing needs you'.
Push goes to every subscribed phone with no per-person routing, so 'Sent to Maren's phone' is only true if her phone is the subscribed one.
Undo does not recall a push already sent.
Register sender email addresses in the portal Settings and decide on a team inbox.
Ask the Lio engineers whether portal data is identical across teams and whether supplier replies create files in the portal.
Reply to Boise about EXW versus DDP terms (low priority since the cards arrive too late anyway) and clarify the sleeve revision B vs C question.
Change the shared portal login that was pasted into Discord after the hack.
Supplier replies cannot be demonstrated on the demo instance because nothing is really sent.
